from pathlib import Path
p=Path(base)/'programs'/'task-89bd6914.py'
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    pairs = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dc in (-1, 1):
                rr, cc = r + 1, c + dc
                if rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    pairs.append((r, c, rr, cc, color))
    for r1, c1, r2, c2, color in pairs:
        dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
        for r, c, sr, sc in ((r1, c1, -dr, -dc), (r2, c2, dr, dc)):
            rr, cc = r + sr, c + sc
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                if grid[rr][cc] != bg:
                    break
                out[rr][cc] = color
                rr += sr
                cc += sc
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(source)
